purpose: Replace the three programmatic power icons (continuation, exhaustion, freeze) with painted icons that match the rest of the set. Exported to images/powers by art_sources/tools/export_powers.py.
style:
Status-effect icon (buff or debuff) for the card game Slay the Spire, part of the same set as the reference icons. Match them closely: a glossy, hand-painted emblem with a bold dark outline, glowing accents and strong contrast. It must stay readable when shrunk to 32 pixels: one simple, bold symbol, no thin lines, no small details.

Composition: one symbol centred, filling about 85% of the canvas, fully visible. Transparent background. No text, numbers or letters, no square frame, no scenery.

jobs.name: continuation
jobs.power: ContinuationPower 接续 (buff: the next 结式 card consumes it for a bonus; expires at end of turn)
jobs.subject: two interlocking rings of flowing blue water forming a chain link, with a bright white-cyan spark where they join, showing one spell carrying on into the next. Same blue palette as the references.

jobs.name: exhaustion
jobs.power: ExhaustionPower 枯竭 (debuff: lose energy next turn after overcasting)
jobs.subject: a drained, cracked mana crystal: a dull violet-grey faceted crystal split by a jagged crack, its inner glow fading to a dim purple, with two small falling shards. Use muted purple and grey so it reads as a debuff, keeping the references' outline and finish.

jobs.name: freeze
jobs.power: FreezePower 冰冻 (enemy debuff: skips a turn once it reaches the counter)
jobs.subject: a bold six-armed ice snowflake crystal in pale icy cyan and white with sharp frosty facets, set on a small round frosty disc. Colder and paler than the water references so ice reads differently from water.
